width="3800" x="40" y="25" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="subtitle" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=15;fontColor=#334155;" value="Aroma Pacífico AWS Organization Baseline (us-east-1, all features enabled | ASM-060, ASM-061): multi-account tree, root controls & SCPs, identity entry points, budgets & cost alerts, audit pipeline for the four mandatory events, and tagging scheme." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="32" width="3800" x="40" y="68" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="org_boundary" parent="1" aroma-pacifico (Region: us-east-1 | All Features Enabled | Single Organization | ASM-060, ASM-061)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="1120" width="3800" x="40" y="115" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="root_controls" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f1f5f9;strokeColor=#334155;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=15;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=12;" value="ORGANIZATION ROOT CONTROLS & POLICIES (Applied from Root | Section 3)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="765" width="715" x="65" y="160" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="box_tag_policy" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="TAG POLICY (Attached to Root | Section 3.2 & Section 5)
• Enforces PascalCase keys across all pilot cloud resources
• Standard Mandatory Keys:
 Client, Project, Environment, Owner, CostCenter, FarmId, CollectionCenter, Name
• Enforced Allowed Values:
 - Environment: dev, qa, pdn, shared (ASM-006, ASM-063)
 - CostCenter: farms, drones, collection-centers, trips, shared (ASM-064)
 - CollectionCenter: cauca, huila, tolima (case statement octets 41, 42, 43)
• Key capitalization enforced for Client and Project (values set after PD-070)
• Tag policy validates compliance upon update/tag; creation presence enforced via SCP" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="230" width="675" x="85" y="200" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="box_scps" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="SERVICE CONTROL POLICIES (SCPs | Attached to Root & OUs | Section 3.1)
1. Deny leaving organization (Attached: Root)
 Denies organizations:LeaveOrganization (prevents accounts escaping trail/budgets/tags)
2. Deny Regions other than us-east-1 (Attached: Root)
 Denies any action outside us-east-1 (exempts global: IAM, Organizations, Budgets | ADR-001)
3. Protect audit trail and storage (Attached: Root)
 Denies cloudtrail:StopLogging, DeleteTrail, UpdateTrail, PutEventSelectors;
 Protects audit archive bucket policy, Object Lock compliance, and KMS key deletion/disabling
4. Deny long-term IAM credentials (Attached: Root)
 Denies iam:CreateUser, iam:CreateAccessKey, iam:CreateLoginProfile (ADR-003)
5. Deny root user of member accounts (Attached: Root)
 Denies all actions by member account root principals (centralized root access mgmt)
6. Require cost tags on creation (Attached: Workloads OU)
 Denies resource creation if Environment or CostCenter tag is missing (aws:RequestTag)
7. Production changes only via pipeline (Attached: Production OU)
 Denies write actions by human IAM Identity Center sessions in pdn (reads allowed);
 Break-glass and narrow ops exempt under incident reference (ADR-003, ASM-007)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="465" width="675" x="85" y="445" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="box_azure" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#94a3b8;strokeWidth=2;strokeDasharray=4 4;fontColor=#334155;fontSize=12.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="Azure (Prepared, not deployed | 10.88.0.0/13 | ADR-001)
• Multi-cloud posture: Azure prepared as an export target and disaster-recovery option.
• No Azure subscription, management group, or deployed resources in the pilot (ADR-001).
• Retains address reservation 10.88.0.0/13 in the addressing plan (A07) without duplicate spend." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="175" width="715" x="65" y="940" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="org_root_junction" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#1e293b;strokeColor=#0f172a;fontColor=#ffffff;fontSize=13.5;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" style="shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.sns;fillColor=#E7157B;strokeColor=#ffffff;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11.5;" value="SNS Alert Topic" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="50" x="1135" y="220" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="mgmt_text" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#bae6fd;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="Roles and Capabilities:
• AWS Organizations Root: master account for SCPs, Tag Policy, and Member Accounts.
• Consolidated Billing: aggregated invoicing across all 6 linked accounts in us-east-1.
• Cost Allocation Tags & Cost Categories: activates Environment, CostCenter, CollectionCenter,
 FarmId, Project; maps CostCenter lines to farms, drones, collection-centers, trips, testing, shared.
• AWS Budgets & Anomaly Detection: 5 cost line budgets, 6 account budgets, 2 anomaly monitors.
• IAM Identity Center Organization Instance [D06]: directory root; administered from Security acct.
• Amazon SNS Topic (KMS-encrypted): broadcasts budget & anomaly alerts to Operator and Cost Owner.
• Automated Budget Guardrail: Testing budget action at 100% applies SCP to NonProduction OU (manual).
• Boundary Rule: Holds NO workload, NO Terraform remote state bucket, NO app identities (ASM-060)." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="355" width="650" x="820" y="290" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell value="Security OU" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="480" width="780" x="1510" y="180" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="sec_acct" parent="1" Account (Environment: shared | Delegated Administrator | ASM-061)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="430" width="750" x="1525" y="215" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_sec_trail" parent="1" value="Data Firehose" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="48" width="48" x="1815" y="255" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_sec_athena" parent="1" style="shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.athena;fillColor=#8C4FFF;strokeColor=#ffffff;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11.5;" value="Athena Workspace" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="48" width="48" x="1905" y="255" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="sec_text" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#a7f3d0;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="Roles and Capabilities:
• Delegated Administrator: CloudTrail organization trail and IAM Identity Center.
• Central Audit Archive Bucket (s3://aroma-audit-archive-shared) [D06]:
 - S3 Object Lock in COMPLIANCE MODE: 5-year immutable retention (ASM-067).
 - Customer-Managed KMS Key (audit key) with restrictive key policy.
 - S3 Block Public Access, Versioning, bucket policy denying non-TLS requests.
 - Key Prefixes: AWSLogs/<org-id>/ (CloudTrail) and application/ (Firehose).
• Amazon Data Firehose: receives application audit records from pdn CloudWatch Logs cross-account.
• Amazon Athena: audit query workspace for Auditor role (read-only queries).
• Multi-Region Organization Trail: logs all management events + S3 drone bucket data events.
• Boundary Rule: Runs no application workloads; single security account matches ADR-001 (ASM-061)." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="305" width="720" x="1540" y="325" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="net_ou" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#faf5ff;strokeColor=#7c3aed;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#4c1d95;fontSize=15;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=12;" value="Infrastructure OU" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="480" width="680" x="2315" y="180" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="net_acct" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#8b5cf6;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#4c1d95;fontSize=13.5;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="Network Account (Environment: shared | Hub & WAN | ASM-033)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="430" width="650" x="2330" y="215" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_net_tgw" parent="1" style="shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.transit_gateway;fillColor=#8C4FFF;strokeColor=#ffffff;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11.5;" value="Transit Gateway" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="48" width="48" x="2350" y="255" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="net_text" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#ddd6fe;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="Roles and Capabilities:
• Collection-Center Hub (ASM-033): AWS Transit Gateway (TGW) terminating WAN links.
• Reserved Address Space: 10.83.0.0/16 held for Network & Security infrastructure (ASM-034).
• Three Collection Center Site Attachments:
 - Cauca Collection Center WAN (10.41.0.0/16, octet 41 | IPsec VPN)
 - Huila Collection Center WAN (10.42.0.0/16, octet 42 | IPsec VPN)
 - Tolima Collection Center WAN (10.43.0.0/16, octet 43 | IPsec VPN)
• Environment VPC Attachments:
 - Production VPC attachment (10.82.0.0/16)
 - Test VPC attachment (10.81.0.0/16)
 - Development VPC attachment (10.80.0.0/16)
• Cross-Account TGW Route Tables & Security Segmentation (firewall-policy.md).
• Boundary Rule: Houses only connectivity and hub routing; holds no workload data." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="305" width="620" x="2345" y="325" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell • Production VPC (10.82.0.0/16) [D04]: application, telemetry, and datastore tiers with private VPC interface endpoints.
• S3 State Bucket (aroma-pdn-tfstate) [D02]: native S3 object locking; KMS state key; accessible only via CI/CD OIDC role.
• GitHub OIDC Federation [D06]: per-environment role pdn-apply with zero static AWS credentials (ADR-003).
• Cognito User Pools [D06]: staff (MFA TOTP) for operators/agronomists; field (passwordless SMS) for farmers/transporters.
• Device Registry [D06, D09]: AWS IoT Core X.509 device certificates for farm nodes and certified drone pilots.
• Data Stores: Telemetry DynamoDB table (5-year retention, KMS key) [D09] & S3 Drone Object Bucket (pdn-drone-objects).
• Application Audit Log Group (/aws/application/audit): records sack reads & threshold changes (365d local retention).
• Cross-Account Streaming: CloudWatch Logs subscription filter forwards audit logs to Firehose in Security Account.
• IoT Core Logs (AWSIotLogsV2): logs rejected connection and publication attempts at ERROR level." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="255" width="1435" x="855" y="915" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="nonprod_ou" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#f59e0b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#78350f;fontSize=13.5;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="NonProduction OU (Target of Testing Budget Action: SCP denies new resource creation on 100% test spend)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="480" width="1460" x="2340" y="720" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="qa_acct" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#94a3b8;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=13.5;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="Test Account (qa | 10.81.0.0/16 | Environment: qa | ASM-006)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="430" width="705" x="2355" y="755" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_qa_vpc" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=11.5;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" value="QA VPC

• Sandbox Environment: dev account for experimental development and testing.
• Dev VPC (10.80.0.0/16) [D04] with development subnet layout.
• S3 State Bucket (aroma-dev-tfstate) [D02] with native object locking.
• GitHub OIDC Federation [D06]: dev-plan and dev-apply IAM roles.
• Dev Instances: Lightweight developer resources, mocks, and sandboxes.
• Audit Logs: Local CloudWatch log group (operational only);
 records are NOT archived to Security account (ASM-068).
• Boundary Rule: Isolated from QA and Production; holds NO production data." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="310" width="675" x="3095" y="860" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="panel_identity" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#334155;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=16;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=12;" value="IDENTITY ENTRY POINTS (Exactly 4 Kinds | Section 4 & docs/security-and-identity.md Section 4)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="770" width="1140" x="40" y="1255" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="id_k1" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="1. AWS Human Operators (Platform Operator, Auditor, Break-Glass) [D06]
• Entry Point: IAM Identity Center (Organization instance in Management Account; delegated admin in Security Account).
• Authentication: Mandatory Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) via TOTP software token on smartphone.
• Access Control: One permission set per role, assigned per account; ZERO long-term IAM users or static keys.
• Role Mapping:
 - Auditor: Read-only access to Audit Archive bucket and Athena query workspace in Security Account.
 - Platform Operator: Operations access to application log groups and AWSIotLogsV2 in workload accounts.
 - Break-Glass: Emergency operational access, invoked only under recorded incident reference (A09)." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="155" width="1100" x="60" y="1295" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="id_k2" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="2. CI / CD Pipeline Automation (GitHub Actions) [D06]
• Entry Point: GitHub OIDC Identity Provider configured in each environment account (dev, qa, pdn).
• Security: Cryptographic OIDC federation exchanging signed GitHub JWT for temporary AWS STS credentials.
• Access Control: Per-environment plan and apply IAM roles (ADR-003). Strictly ZERO static credentials or stored AWS keys." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="1100" x="60" y="1465" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="id_k3" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="3. Hardware Devices (Crop Nodes, Drying Nodes, and Drones) [D06]
• Entry Point: AWS IoT Core Thing Registry in each workload account (dev, qa, pdn).
• Authentication: Mutual TLS (mTLS) with unique X.509 client certificate registered from CSR (port 8883 / 443 ALPN).
• Certificate Lifecycle: Immediate revocation by certificate status check. Drones obtain upload grants before flight delivery." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="1100" x="60" y="1590" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="id_k4" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="4. Application Users (8 Business Roles | security-and-identity.md Section 4) [D06]
• Entry Point: Amazon Cognito User Pools located in the workload account (pdn):
 * Staff Pool (MFA required with TOTP):
 - Collection-Center Operator, Drone Operator, Agronomist, Platform Operator.
 - Sensitive operations (fumigation authorization, threshold change, cert revoke) require re-authentication if auth_time > 10 min.
 * Field Pool (No MFA, justified adoption decision ASM-091):
 - Farmer, Transporter, Read-Only Buyer.
 - Passwordless SMS code to registered phone; 30-day refresh token; hardware-backed keystore offline outbox encryption (ASM-095).
 * Anonymous Public Reader:
 - Public sack lookup by code only; unauthenticated, no Cognito user pool (ASM-069). Zero cédula or full trace returned." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="210" width="1100" x="60" y="1715" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="panel_audit" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#047857;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#064e3b;fontSize=16;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=12;" value="AUDIT PIPELINE FOR THE FOUR MANDATORY EVENTS (Section 7 | 5-Year Retention under Object Lock)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="770" width="1500" x="1205" y="1255" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="audit_ov" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#10b981;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="Dual-Layer Audit Architecture (Section 7):
• Layer 1 (AWS CloudTrail): Authoritative for AWS API calls made by identifiable principals (S3 flight object uploads, pipeline apply).
• Layer 2 (Application & IoT Core): Authoritative for domain business events (sack reads, threshold changes, MQTT publications).
• Compliance Retention: All audit records stored for 5 years in Security Account under S3 Object Lock compliance mode (ASM-067)." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="95" width="1460" x="1225" y="1295" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ev1_box" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f0fdf4;strokeColor=#86efac;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#064e3b;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=8;" value="1. Sack Read Audit (Public Web, Farmer App, Center App)
• Writing Layer: Application lookup service (CloudFront + WAF + Lambda URL).
• Audit Record: Structured JSON written to /aws/application/audit in pdn.
• Content: Authenticated user and role (buyer, farmer, center op) or 'anonymous' (ASM-069);
 sack code, view returned (buyer/center/farmer), result (found/not found/denied),
 UTC timestamp, source IP, channel (web/farmer/center app), user agent.
• Privacy Guard: NO national ID (cédula) and NO full trace recorded (Point 2 requirement).
• Shipping Path: CloudWatch Subscription -> Data Firehose -> s3://audit-archive/application/" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="185" width="715" x="1225" y="1405" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ev2_box" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f0fdf4;strokeColor=#86efac;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#064e3b;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=8;" value="2. Threshold Change Audit (Reports Web / Threshold Config)
• Writing Layer: Application threshold service (written in same transaction).
• Audit Record: Structured JSON written to /aws/application/audit in pdn.
• Content: Federation agronomist or platform operator identity with MFA; variable,
 zone (crop/drying), scope (pilot/farm), old value, new value, reason, UTC time, source IP.
• Secondary Audit: CloudTrail write-only data events on thresholds DynamoDB table (PD-074).
• Shipping Path: CloudWatch Subscription -> Data Firehose -> s3://audit-archive/application/" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="185" width="715" x="1970" y="1405" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ev3_box" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f0fdf4;strokeColor=#86efac;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#064e3b;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=8;" value="3. Telemetry Publication Audit (Crop & Drying MQTT Readings)
• Writing Layer: AWS IoT Core.
• Accepted Publications: Telemetry topic rule writes reading + metadata directly to
 DynamoDB telemetry store: node ID, cert principal, client ID, source IP, receive time, original timestamp.
• Rejected Publications: Authorization or TLS failures logged at ERROR level in AWSIotLogsV2 log group.
• Retention: 5 years in DynamoDB telemetry store (case statement requirement for readings).
• Ingress Path: Direct via cellular bearer to regional IoT Core endpoint (bypasses center & VPC)." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="175" width="715" x="1225" y="1605" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ev4_box" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f0fdf4;strokeColor=#86efac;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#064e3b;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=8;" value="4. Flight Object Delivery Audit (Drone Mission Upload)
• Writing Layer: AWS CloudTrail (S3 Data Events) and Reception Lambda Function.
• Audit Record: CloudTrail S3 data events (PutObject, CompleteMultipartUpload) on pdn drone
 bucket by ARN prefix. Captures principal, bucket, key, version, size, eventTime, source IP.
• Flight Linking: Reception function links S3 object to flight record in transactional store (ADR-002).
• Pilot Attribution: Upload-grant record binds pilot identity & drone kit to upload authorization (PD-075).
• Shipping Path: Multi-Region Organization Trail -> s3://audit-archive/AWSLogs/<org-id>/" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="175" width="715" x="1970" y="1605" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="audit_stor" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#10b981;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="Centralized Audit Storage & Verification (Security Account)
• Target S3 Bucket: s3://aroma-audit-archive-shared (us-east-1)
• Integrity & Compliance: S3 Object Lock in COMPLIANCE MODE (5-year default retention, ASM-067). Cannot be shortened or deleted by any user or root.
• Encryption: Customer-Managed KMS Key (audit key) under Security account policy. S3 Block Public Access, Versioning, TLS 1.2+ enforce.
• Partitioning: s3://.../AWSLogs/<org-id>/ (CloudTrail org events) | s3://.../application/ (Firehose-streamed application audit logs)
• Verification: Amazon Athena workspace configured for Auditor role to execute SQL queries across both audit streams." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="155" width="1260" x="1225" y="1800" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="auditor_card" parent="1" style="shape=umlActor;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;html=1;outlineConnect=0;fillColor=#064e3b;strokeColor=#064e3b;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;" value="Auditor Role
(IAM Identity Center)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="70" width="45" x="2540" y="1820" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="athena_badge" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#8C4FFF;strokeColor=#ffffff;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#ffffff;fontSize=11.5;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" value="Athena SQL
Workspace" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="45" width="95" x="2605" y="1835" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="edge_auditor_athena" edge="1" parent="1" source="athena_badge" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#059669;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=11.5;fontColor=#059669;align=center;" target="audit_stor" value="Queries"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="edge_ev4_to_storage" edge="1" parent="1" source="ev4_box" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#059669;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=11;fontColor=#064e3b;align=center;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;entryX=0.8;entryY=0;" target="audit_stor" value="CloudTrail Org Trail Stream -> AWSLogs/<org-id>/"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="panel_budgets" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#b45309;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#78350f;fontSize=16;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=12;" value="BUDGETS & COST ALERTING ARCHITECTURE (Section 6 | Management Account)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="770" width="1110" x="2730" y="1255" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="budgets_ov_box" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#f59e0b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="Centralized Cost Governance (Section 6):
• All budgets created in Management Account over linked accounts; values follow A23 cost model (PD-076).
• Historical note: 2020 prices are retired; no 2020 figure is used for budget baselines (legacy-2020.md).
• Budgets split by cost allocation tags and linked accounts to mirror the 5 case dimensions." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="95" width="1070" x="2750" y="1295" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="budgets_cat_box" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fffbeb;strokeColor=#fde68a;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#78350f;fontSize=12.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="AWS Budgets Catalog (11 Monthly Cost Budgets | Section 6)
1. Farms Budget: Filter CostCenter = farms, pdn account. Ingestion, telemetry store, threshold function.
2. Drones Budget: Filter CostCenter = drones, pdn account. Ingress, S3 flight objects, inference functions.
3. Collection Centers Budget: Filter CostCenter = collection-centers, pdn; child budget per center.
4. Trips Budget: Filter CostCenter = trips, pdn account. Transporter position ingestion and store.
5. Testing Budget: Linked accounts test (qa) and development (dev), all cost (ASM-064).
6. Account Budgets (6 budgets): One budget per linked account (mgmt, sec, net, pdn, qa, dev).

Alert Threshold Triggers (ASM-066):
• Actual 80 % (early warning) | Actual 100 % (budget reached) | Forecasted 100 % (month-end projection)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="245" width="1070" x="2750" y="1405" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="budgets_flow_box" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#f59e0b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="Alert Path and Automated Budget Actions (Section 6)
• Alert Notification Flow:
 AWS Budgets + AWS Cost Anomaly Detection (2 monitors: linked account & CostCenter tag)
 --> Amazon SNS Topic in Management Account (encrypted with customer-managed KMS key)
 --> Subscribers: Platform Operator role and designated Cost Owner (email / SMS).
• Testing Budget Automated Action (Guardrail):
 * Trigger: At actual 100% test spend on Testing Budget.
 * Governance Gate: Requires MANUAL APPROVAL by Cost Owner / Lead.
 * Action: Applies SCP to NonProduction OU denying creation of new AWS resources.
• Production Protection Rule (RTO Guardrail):
 * Production OU NEVER receives an automatic budget stop action.
 * Preserves continuous farmer alert delivery and public sack lookup (4-hour RTO requirement)." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="255" width="1070" x="2750" y="1665" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#475569;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12.2;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="Shared Resource Usage-Based Cost Allocation Formula (ASM-065):
Cost of Entity (e) = Monthly Cost of Shared Resource Family x (Usage Units of e in Month / Total Units in Month)
• Telemetry & Thresholds (farms): Usage = accepted readings per farm (telemetry DynamoDB store).
• Drone Ingress & S3 Storage (drones): Usage = flight objects and stored bytes per farm and campaign (S3 prefixes).
• Transporter Position Store (trips): Usage = position tracking messages per trip.
• Public Lookup & Sack Store (shared -> farms): Usage = sack reads per farm of origin (application audit log).
• Network Hub & TGW (collection-centers): Direct tags where per-center; shared hub cost split equally (1/3 each).

Diagram Box Badges Catalog (docs/architecture.md Section 14 Traceability to IaC):
• [D02]: S3 remote state bucket per environment with native object locking (B02)
• [D03]: Per-environment configuration, secrets management, and common_tags (B03)
• [D04]: VPC boundaries, tiers, and private endpoints of pattern environment (B04)
• [D06]: IAM Identity Center, Cognito User Pools, GitHub OIDC, and KMS keys (B06)
• [D09]: Telemetry ingestion pattern module, IoT topic rule & DynamoDB store (B09)

Key Decision Log Citations:
ASM-060 (Management acct), ASM-061 (Direct Org, no Control Tower), ASM-062 (OU-level SCPs),
ASM-063 (Shared env tag), ASM-064 (CostCenter values & testing scope), ASM-065 (Shared cost formula),
ASM-066 (Budget alert thresholds), ASM-067 (5-year Object Lock retention), ASM-068 (Dev/QA audit logs not archived),
ASM-069 (Anonymous public sack audit), ADR-001 (us-east-1, Azure prepared), ADR-002 (Combined flight mode), ADR-003 (OIDC, state buckets)." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="470" width="1465" x="2350" y="2090" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
TAG POLICY (Attached to Root | Section 3.2 & Section 5)
• Enforces PascalCase keys across all pilot cloud resources
• Standard Mandatory Keys:
Client, Project, Environment, Owner, CostCenter, FarmId, CollectionCenter, Name
• Enforced Allowed Values:
- Environment: dev, qa, pdn, shared (ASM-006, ASM-063)
- CostCenter: farms, drones, collection-centers, trips, shared (ASM-064)
- CollectionCenter: cauca, huila, tolima (case statement octets 41, 42, 43)
• Key capitalization enforced for Client and Project (values set after PD-070)
• Tag policy validates compliance upon update/tag; creation presence enforced via SCP

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 657px; height: 1px; padding-top: 445px; margin-left: 66px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #0f172a;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12.5px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#0f172a, #d3daea); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
SERVICE CONTROL POLICIES (SCPs | Attached to Root & OUs | Section 3.1)
1. Deny leaving organization (Attached: Root)
Denies organizations:LeaveOrganization (prevents accounts escaping trail/budgets/tags)
2. Deny Regions other than us-east-1 (Attached: Root)
Denies any action outside us-east-1 (exempts global: IAM, Organizations, Budgets | ADR-001)
3. Protect audit trail and storage (Attached: Root)
Denies cloudtrail:StopLogging, DeleteTrail, UpdateTrail, PutEventSelectors;
Protects audit archive bucket policy, Object Lock compliance, and KMS key deletion/disabling
4. Deny long-term IAM credentials (Attached: Root)
Denies iam:CreateUser, iam:CreateAccessKey, iam:CreateLoginProfile (ADR-003)
5. Deny root user of member accounts (Attached: Root)
Denies all actions by member account root principals (centralized root access mgmt)
6. Require cost tags on creation (Attached: Workloads OU)
Denies resource creation if Environment or CostCenter tag is missing (aws:RequestTag)
7. Production changes only via pipeline (Attached: Production OU)
Denies write actions by human IAM Identity Center sessions in pdn (reads allowed);
Break-glass and narrow ops exempt under incident reference (ADR-003, ASM-007)

div.div:
Roles and Capabilities:
• AWS Organizations Root: master account for SCPs, Tag Policy, and Member Accounts.
• Consolidated Billing: aggregated invoicing across all 6 linked accounts in us-east-1.
• Cost Allocation Tags & Cost Categories: activates Environment, CostCenter, CollectionCenter,
FarmId, Project; maps CostCenter lines to farms, drones, collection-centers, trips, testing, shared.
• AWS Budgets & Anomaly Detection: 5 cost line budgets, 6 account budgets, 2 anomaly monitors.
• IAM Identity Center Organization Instance [D06]: directory root; administered from Security acct.
• Amazon SNS Topic (KMS-encrypted): broadcasts budget & anomaly alerts to Operator and Cost Owner.
• Automated Budget Guardrail: Testing budget action at 100% applies SCP to NonProduction OU (manual).
• Boundary Rule: Holds NO workload, NO Terraform remote state bucket, NO app identities (ASM-060).

div.div:
Roles and Capabilities:
• Delegated Administrator: CloudTrail organization trail and IAM Identity Center.
• Central Audit Archive Bucket (s3://aroma-audit-archive-shared) [D06]:
- S3 Object Lock in COMPLIANCE MODE: 5-year immutable retention (ASM-067).
- Customer-Managed KMS Key (audit key) with restrictive key policy.
- S3 Block Public Access, Versioning, bucket policy denying non-TLS requests.
- Key Prefixes: AWSLogs// (CloudTrail) and application/ (Firehose).
• Amazon Data Firehose: receives application audit records from pdn CloudWatch Logs cross-account.
• Amazon Athena: audit query workspace for Auditor role (read-only queries).
• Multi-Region Organization Trail: logs all management events + S3 drone bucket data events.
• Boundary Rule: Runs no application workloads; single security account matches ADR-001 (ASM-061).

div.div:
Roles and Capabilities:
• Collection-Center Hub (ASM-033): AWS Transit Gateway (TGW) terminating WAN links.
• Reserved Address Space: 10.83.0.0/16 held for Network & Security infrastructure (ASM-034).
• Three Collection Center Site Attachments:
- Cauca Collection Center WAN (10.41.0.0/16, octet 41 | IPsec VPN)
- Huila Collection Center WAN (10.42.0.0/16, octet 42 | IPsec VPN)
- Tolima Collection Center WAN (10.43.0.0/16, octet 43 | IPsec VPN)
• Environment VPC Attachments:
- Production VPC attachment (10.82.0.0/16)
- Test VPC attachment (10.81.0.0/16)
- Development VPC attachment (10.80.0.0/16)
• Cross-Account TGW Route Tables & Security Segmentation (firewall-policy.md).
• Boundary Rule: Houses only connectivity and hub routing; holds no workload data.

div.div:
Production Components and Governance:
• Production VPC (10.82.0.0/16) [D04]: application, telemetry, and datastore tiers with private VPC interface endpoints.
• S3 State Bucket (aroma-pdn-tfstate) [D02]: native S3 object locking; KMS state key; accessible only via CI/CD OIDC role.
• GitHub OIDC Federation [D06]: per-environment role pdn-apply with zero static AWS credentials (ADR-003).
• Cognito User Pools [D06]: staff (MFA TOTP) for operators/agronomists; field (passwordless SMS) for farmers/transporters.
• Device Registry [D06, D09]: AWS IoT Core X.509 device certificates for farm nodes and certified drone pilots.
• Data Stores: Telemetry DynamoDB table (5-year retention, KMS key) [D09] & S3 Drone Object Bucket (pdn-drone-objects).
• Application Audit Log Group (/aws/application/audit): records sack reads & threshold changes (365d local retention).
• Cross-Account Streaming: CloudWatch Logs subscription filter forwards audit logs to Firehose in Security Account.
• IoT Core Logs (AWSIotLogsV2): logs rejected connection and publication attempts at ERROR level.

Test Account Components:
• The Pattern Environment: qa is the test environment coded in Epic 6.
• QA VPC (10.81.0.0/16) [D04] with subnets matching the addressing plan.
• S3 State Bucket (aroma-qa-tfstate) [D02] with native object locking.
• GitHub OIDC Federation [D06]: qa-plan and qa-apply IAM roles.
• Test Instances: Cognito User Pools, IoT Core, and test Lambda functions.
• Audit Logs: Local CloudWatch log group (operational testing only);
records are NOT archived to Security account (ASM-068).
• Boundary Rule: Strictly isolated from production; holds NO production data.

• Sandbox Environment: dev account for experimental development and testing.
• Dev VPC (10.80.0.0/16) [D04] with development subnet layout.

records are NOT archived to Security account (ASM-068).

div.div: IDENTITY ENTRY POINTS (Exactly 4 Kinds | Section 4 & docs/security-and-identity.md Section 4)

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1082px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1295px; margin-left: 41px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #0f172a;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12.5px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#0f172a, #d3daea); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
1. AWS Human Operators (Platform Operator, Auditor, Break-Glass) [D06]
• Entry Point: IAM Identity Center (Organization instance in Management Account; delegated admin in Security Account).
• Authentication: Mandatory Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) via TOTP software token on smartphone.
• Access Control: One permission set per role, assigned per account; ZERO long-term IAM users or static keys.
• Role Mapping:
- Auditor: Read-only access to Audit Archive bucket and Athena query workspace in Security Account.
- Platform Operator: Operations access to application log groups and AWSIotLogsV2 in workload accounts.
- Break-Glass: Emergency operational access, invoked only under recorded incident reference (A09).

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1082px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1465px; margin-left: 41px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #0f172a;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12.5px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#0f172a, #d3daea); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
2. CI / CD Pipeline Automation (GitHub Actions) [D06]
• Entry Point: GitHub OIDC Identity Provider configured in each environment account (dev, qa, pdn).
• Security: Cryptographic OIDC federation exchanging signed GitHub JWT for temporary AWS STS credentials.
• Access Control: Per-environment plan and apply IAM roles (ADR-003). Strictly ZERO static credentials or stored AWS keys.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1082px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1590px; margin-left: 41px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #0f172a;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12.5px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#0f172a, #d3daea); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
3. Hardware Devices (Crop Nodes, Drying Nodes, and Drones) [D06]
• Entry Point: AWS IoT Core Thing Registry in each workload account (dev, qa, pdn).
• Authentication: Mutual TLS (mTLS) with unique X.509 client certificate registered from CSR (port 8883 / 443 ALPN).
• Certificate Lifecycle: Immediate revocation by certificate status check. Drones obtain upload grants before flight delivery.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1082px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1715px; margin-left: 41px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #0f172a;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12.5px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#0f172a, #d3daea); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
4. Application Users (8 Business Roles | security-and-identity.md Section 4) [D06]
• Entry Point: Amazon Cognito User Pools located in the workload account (pdn):
* Staff Pool (MFA required with TOTP):
- Collection-Center Operator, Drone Operator, Agronomist, Platform Operator.
- Sensitive operations (fumigation authorization, threshold change, cert revoke) require re-authentication if auth_time > 10 min.
* Field Pool (No MFA, justified adoption decision ASM-091):
- Farmer, Transporter, Read-Only Buyer.
- Passwordless SMS code to registered phone; 30-day refresh token; hardware-backed keystore offline outbox encryption (ASM-095).
* Anonymous Public Reader:
- Public sack lookup by code only; unauthenticated, no Cognito user pool (ASM-069). Zero cédula or full trace returned.

div.div:
Dual-Layer Audit Architecture (Section 7):
• Layer 1 (AWS CloudTrail): Authoritative for AWS API calls made by identifiable principals (S3 flight object uploads, pipeline apply).
• Layer 2 (Application & IoT Core): Authoritative for domain business events (sack reads, threshold changes, MQTT publications).
• Compliance Retention: All audit records stored for 5 years in Security Account under S3 Object Lock compliance mode (ASM-067).

div.div:
1. Sack Read Audit (Public Web, Farmer App, Center App)
• Writing Layer: Application lookup service (CloudFront + WAF + Lambda URL).
• Audit Record: Structured JSON written to /aws/application/audit in pdn.
• Content: Authenticated user and role (buyer, farmer, center op) or 'anonymous' (ASM-069);
sack code, view returned (buyer/center/farmer), result (found/not found/denied),
UTC timestamp, source IP, channel (web/farmer/center app), user agent.
• Privacy Guard: NO national ID (cédula) and NO full trace recorded (Point 2 requirement).
• Shipping Path: CloudWatch Subscription -> Data Firehose -> s3://audit-archive/application/

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(240, 253, 244), rgb(15, 26, 19)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(134, 239, 172), rgb(0, 78, 21));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 701px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1403px; margin-left: 1949px;

div.div:
2. Threshold Change Audit (Reports Web / Threshold Config)
• Writing Layer: Application threshold service (written in same transaction).
• Audit Record: Structured JSON written to /aws/application/audit in pdn.
• Content: Federation agronomist or platform operator identity with MFA; variable,
zone (crop/drying), scope (pilot/farm), old value, new value, reason, UTC time, source IP.
• Secondary Audit: CloudTrail write-only data events on thresholds DynamoDB table (PD-074).
• Shipping Path: CloudWatch Subscription -> Data Firehose -> s3://audit-archive/application/

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(240, 253, 244), rgb(15, 26, 19)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(134, 239, 172), rgb(0, 78, 21));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 701px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1603px; margin-left: 1204px;

div.div:
3. Telemetry Publication Audit (Crop & Drying MQTT Readings)
• Writing Layer: AWS IoT Core.
• Accepted Publications: Telemetry topic rule writes reading + metadata directly to
DynamoDB telemetry store: node ID, cert principal, client ID, source IP, receive time, original timestamp.
• Rejected Publications: Authorization or TLS failures logged at ERROR level in AWSIotLogsV2 log group.
• Retention: 5 years in DynamoDB telemetry store (case statement requirement for readings).
• Ingress Path: Direct via cellular bearer to regional IoT Core endpoint (bypasses center & VPC).

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(240, 253, 244), rgb(15, 26, 19)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(134, 239, 172), rgb(0, 78, 21));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 701px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1603px; margin-left: 1949px;

div.div:
4. Flight Object Delivery Audit (Drone Mission Upload)
• Writing Layer: AWS CloudTrail (S3 Data Events) and Reception Lambda Function.
• Audit Record: CloudTrail S3 data events (PutObject, CompleteMultipartUpload) on pdn drone
bucket by ARN prefix. Captures principal, bucket, key, version, size, eventTime, source IP.
• Flight Linking: Reception function links S3 object to flight record in transactional store (ADR-002).
• Pilot Attribution: Upload-grant record binds pilot identity & drone kit to upload authorization (PD-075).
• Shipping Path: Multi-Region Organization Trail -> s3://audit-archive/AWSLogs//

div.div:
Centralized Audit Storage & Verification (Security Account)
• Target S3 Bucket: s3://aroma-audit-archive-shared (us-east-1)
• Integrity & Compliance: S3 Object Lock in COMPLIANCE MODE (5-year default retention, ASM-067). Cannot be shortened or deleted by any user or root.
• Encryption: Customer-Managed KMS Key (audit key) under Security account policy. S3 Block Public Access, Versioning, TLS 1.2+ enforce.
• Partitioning: s3://.../AWSLogs// (CloudTrail org events) | s3://.../application/ (Firehose-streamed application audit logs)
• Verification: Amazon Athena workspace configured for Auditor role to execute SQL queries across both audit streams.

div.div:
Centralized Cost Governance (Section 6):
• All budgets created in Management Account over linked accounts; values follow A23 cost model (PD-076).
• Historical note: 2020 prices are retired; no 2020 figure is used for budget baselines (legacy-2020.md).
• Budgets split by cost allocation tags and linked accounts to mirror the 5 case dimensions.

div.div:
AWS Budgets Catalog (11 Monthly Cost Budgets | Section 6)
1. Farms Budget: Filter CostCenter = farms, pdn account. Ingestion, telemetry store, threshold function.
2. Drones Budget: Filter CostCenter = drones, pdn account. Ingress, S3 flight objects, inference functions.
3. Collection Centers Budget: Filter CostCenter = collection-centers, pdn; child budget per center.
4. Trips Budget: Filter CostCenter = trips, pdn account. Transporter position ingestion and store.
5. Testing Budget: Linked accounts test (qa) and development (dev), all cost (ASM-064).
6. Account Budgets (6 budgets): One budget per linked account (mgmt, sec, net, pdn, qa, dev).
Alert Threshold Triggers (ASM-066):
• Actual 80 % (early warning) | Actual 100 % (budget reached) | Forecasted 100 % (month-end projection)

div.div:
Alert Path and Automated Budget Actions (Section 6)
• Alert Notification Flow:
AWS Budgets + AWS Cost Anomaly Detection (2 monitors: linked account & CostCenter tag)
--> Amazon SNS Topic in Management Account (encrypted with customer-managed KMS key)
--> Subscribers: Platform Operator role and designated Cost Owner (email / SMS).
• Testing Budget Automated Action (Guardrail):
* Trigger: At actual 100% test spend on Testing Budget.
* Governance Gate: Requires MANUAL APPROVAL by Cost Owner / Lead.
* Action: Applies SCP to NonProduction OU denying creation of new AWS resources.
• Production Protection Rule (RTO Guardrail):
* Production OU NEVER receives an automatic budget stop action.
* Preserves continuous farmer alert delivery and public sack lookup (4-hour RTO requirement).

div.div:
Shared Resource Usage-Based Cost Allocation Formula (ASM-065):
Cost of Entity (e) = Monthly Cost of Shared Resource Family x (Usage Units of e in Month / Total Units in Month)
• Telemetry & Thresholds (farms): Usage = accepted readings per farm (telemetry DynamoDB store).
• Drone Ingress & S3 Storage (drones): Usage = flight objects and stored bytes per farm and campaign (S3 prefixes).
• Transporter Position Store (trips): Usage = position tracking messages per trip.
• Public Lookup & Sack Store (shared -> farms): Usage = sack reads per farm of origin (application audit log).
• Network Hub & TGW (collection-centers): Direct tags where per-center; shared hub cost split equally (1/3 each).
Diagram Box Badges Catalog (docs/architecture.md Section 14 Traceability to IaC):
• [D02]: S3 remote state bucket per environment with native object locking (B02)
• [D03]: Per-environment configuration, secrets management, and common_tags (B03)
• [D04]: VPC boundaries, tiers, and private endpoints of pattern environment (B04)
• [D06]: IAM Identity Center, Cognito User Pools, GitHub OIDC, and KMS keys (B06)
• [D09]: Telemetry ingestion pattern module, IoT topic rule & DynamoDB store (B09)
Key Decision Log Citations:
ASM-060 (Management acct), ASM-061 (Direct Org, no Control Tower), ASM-062 (OU-level SCPs),
ASM-063 (Shared env tag), ASM-064 (CostCenter values & testing scope), ASM-065 (Shared cost formula),
ASM-066 (Budget alert thresholds), ASM-067 (5-year Object Lock retention), ASM-068 (Dev/QA audit logs not archived),
ASM-069 (Anonymous public sack audit), ADR-001 (us-east-1, Azure prepared), ADR-002 (Combined flight mode), ADR-003 (OIDC, state buckets).
